rules: drop holdout rows (sha256(case_id) % 10 == 0) and truncated traces (finish_reason length)
drop traces containing <think>, </think> or a chat special token (counted, not stripped)
row text = the CoT prompt + the trace
keep boxed traces only; sort by (-chars of the answer part, case_id, key); take the first N
check: no holdout row, no drop-list or K1 pair, every case_id a TRAIN case of the spec's sources
n_rule: ceil(21,087 x 2400 / 2048): the file holds 2400/2048 of what the fit keeps

fit_keeps.retention_pool_rule: 2048 x 36,149 / 3,511 (earlier pool size scaled by the training steps)
